cohort: The study included 4981 women who had a singleton birth in Washington State between 2003-2014 after undergoing an external cephalic version procedure.
finding: 57.2% of version attempts were successful, with primiparity and multiparity associated with higher success rates, and oligohydramnios associated with lower success rates.
mod_finding: Successful external cephalic version procedures are reinforced to potentially reduce the frequency of caesarean birth.
